transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster (13.55 px/cm). Boundaries printed on the right axis; bar edges agree with every printed value. Hardness from bar ends vs gridlines (I/K/P/1F/4F/F at 707/967/1227/1487/1747/2007 px, 260 px per class; thirds as +/-). Red highlight lines lie just below the 160, 150, 138, 100 and 68 cm boundaries, each spanning the bar width of the layer below, so the layer below gets 'highlighted red'. Left boxes: three with bold test codes (168, 160, 138 cm; X2 kept in raw) and three undated-code label boxes at 150, 100, 68 cm (date_tag on the layer whose top is at the leader, interface rule). Temperatures are break points of a continuous red polyline without markers (fitted segment intersections; highlight rows excluded), calibration x = 2115.5 + 46.80*T(C) (no air temp printed); all break points on 0.5 C steps, +-0.2 C / +-0.5 cm; straight stretches 100-60 and 40-0 cm hide any collinear points. Water content column blank for all layers. No density column.
